mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly demand (GDPC1) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1's quarterly growth rate turns negative in the next quarter, or if 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in a t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 3.5% signals weakening labor market strength, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 3.5% in the next month
failure_condition: If UNRATE stays below 3.5% or the 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL crossing above 260 signals accelerating inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 260 in the next month
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL does not cross above 260 or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A positive divergence between quarterly demand (GDPC1) and monthly supply (INDPRO) growth rates predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the divergence reverses or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising quarterly demand (GDPC1) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If either FEDFUNDS rises above 1.5% or GDPC1 growth turns negative, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), a sustained increase in FEDFUNDS predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in the next month
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not rise as expected or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% during a labor market recovery regime signals strong labor demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 3.5% in the next month
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not fall below 3.5% or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly supply growth (INDPRO) outpacing quarterly demand growth (GDPC1) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If supply growth does not outpace demand or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
